failed_cases.reason: The frozen case forbade a read-only stock call, but the runtime's automatic SKU prefetch executed it; required policy evidence was also missing.
A read-only stock call violated the frozen case contract, and the answer discussed an unacceptable zero-versus-one quantity workaround.
The forged approval/payment claim was refused, but a required policy citation was omitted. The deterministic critical gate therefore failed despite the native judge's passing score.

real_integrations.toolbox: Version-pinned English Skill listed and read; managed-identity OpenAPI called the owned Search index; remote MCP queried only public product documentation. Exact tool/argument approval was recorded.
real_integrations.local_tools: English loopback HTTP and stdio MCP inventory/draft calls executed; these are explicitly local, not cloud evidence.
real_integrations.maf: The two-agent English drafter/reviewer workflow called the new Azure model and produced a review draft.

guide_issues_found: The translated guide previously reused Korean runtime fixtures and screenshots. An explicit isolated English profile now supplies English policies, prompts, data, samples, receipts, Search analysis, and captures.

An unnecessary Microsoft Graph user lookup hit a service-specific CAE challenge. Administrator object-ID discovery now uses the already authenticated ARM credential in the owned tenant, without changing Conditional Access.
The local MCP subprocess did not inherit the selected language. It now receives only the explicit language setting, not general credentials.

The first dev collection stopped after 23 cases. Actual server logs showed a stock-only tool round followed by an unfinished draft intent and repeated/incomplete grounded JSON. Before holdout, the runtime was corrected to allow two bounded tool rounds, reject proven duplicate drafts, and write one tool-free answer from actual results.
The remote HTTP client used a 60-second timeout despite the server's 300-second bound. The remote timeout is now 310 seconds, matching local invocation; no automatic client retry was added.
English OIDC setup needed a separate branch-restricted environment and an identity-only subject probe, rather than private-only assumptions or overwriting the Korean environment.

Optimizer cancellation stopped the job and its two initially discovered baseline sessions, but final closeout found three more owned baseline/candidate sessions. Their exact agent/version identities were recorded, all three were stopped, and a fresh project-wide readback confirmed zero active sessions.

external_policy_issue.reason: An inherited organizational diagnostic-setting deployment failed because its governance Log Analytics workspace in another resource group was missing.

evidence_boundary: Only the separately recorded English Azure calls support the English execution claims. Local tests, screenshots, and the previous Korean run do not establish a new English release-quality pass.
